sections.heading: New
items: OpenAI models inside AI chat: We are bringing GPT 5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna to the side chat, along with Opus 5 and Fable 5.
Localization: Palmier Pro now supports 15 new languages. Go to Settings > General > Languages.
Appearance settings: Choose a light, dark, or system theme, switch workspace layouts with ⌘1–⌘3, and customize timeline clip colors

sections.heading: Improved
items: Agent thinking: You can now see thinking token to understand the Agent's reasoning while it works
Agent clip linking: The Agent can now link and unlink clips to build J and L cuts
